The detail read is public for ALL statuses (incl. auto-hidden).

Location section: a static Leaflet map (page-scoped LeafletService,
same service as /map) zoomed to the shelter (SHELTER_ZOOM 16) with one
non-interactive marker. No picking, no marker navigation.
Reviews require an authenticated, VERIFIED account (any claim).
The detail page owns the branch (forms stay dumb): ReviewForm
emits {rating, comment}, ShelterDetailPage makes the call.
One review per user per shelter - the backend upserts:
the first save of a session is always POST and returns 201
(created) or 200 (updated a prior-session review - the page
adopts it and switches to edit mode, PUT /mine afterwards).
add(123, rating, comment) ' first save of the session
The v1 review DTO has no author identity, so the page tracks the
user's own review in a per-session signal (06-CONTEXT decision 2).
Fresh page load = add mode; after a save, edit mode.
Verified only: anonymous / unverified get the login/verify prompts
(the "My review" vocabulary). One report per (shelter, user, type) -
the duplicate check (409) runs BEFORE the shared per-user throttle
"Report" -> pick a type (It does not exist / It is closed / It is open / The location is wrong / Something else) + detail (OTHER only, <= 500)

the server's message inline near the picker (role=status)
The "Report" link renders on every review EXCEPT the caller's own -
own reviews are never reportable (the backend 403s too).
The 5th report hides the review server-side (hidden_at - the author
"Report" on a review -> pick a reason (False or misleading / Not relevant / Spam / Something else) + detail (optional)
refetched (a newly hidden review disappears for everyone but its author)
Three large band buttons (Space available / Getting full / Full) -
one tap, latest-wins upsert (NO 409: a re-tap is the update).
Pre-selected from the detail DTO's yourOccupancyBand. Display-only
server-side: 2 h freshness, latest fresh band wins, 1 agreeing report
Route /submit guarded by AuthGuard + VerifiedGuard. The location
section keeps ONE shared location signal written by FIVE capture
modes: (1) smart text input - coordinate strings (incl. DMS, auto
lng/lat swap), long-form map URLs parsed client-side by the pure
geolocation; (3) mini-map click/drag; (4) maps.app.goo.gl short links
resolved by the backend (POST /api/geo/resolve); (5) Estonia address
search - client-side Nominatim geocoding via GeocodeGateway (one
deliberate request per press, hard 1 req/s spacing, always-rendered
coordinate readout (+ source/swapped/accuracy hints) is a DISPLAY of
the shared signal, not a capture mode. A FAILED capture clears the pin
(never a silent stale pin) - a failed address SEARCH never touches the
pin (inline state only, never blocks submit). The page pre-checks the
Estonia bbox client-side (inline error, nothing is sent) and the
capture the location (any order, repeats allowed)
shared location set - marker + read-only readout
inline error on no-pair / out-of-bounds / invalid
marker at device position + accuracy hint
shared location set (same as a pick)
inline error (pin cleared; 429 = "try again in a minute")
results (429 -> "please wait a moment"; network -> generic copy)
shared location set + address field prefilled ONLY IF empty
A failed SEARCH (no results / 429 / network) never touches the pin -
inline state only, never blocks submit.
banner with message (input preserved; 403 adds a /verify link; 409 = "The limit of 10 active shelters has been reached")
USER-submitted rows are sacred on the backend: the registry
importer never touches source=USER shelters. Author-scoped
management (M8) is the one exception - see below.
